description: Cs₂NaFeF₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. There are two inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded to twelve F atoms to form distorted CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with nine CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with three equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, faces with seven CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with three equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and faces with four FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 1°. There are a spread of Cs-F bond distances ranging from 3.19-3.26 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded to twelve F atoms to form distorted CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with nine CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with three equivalent FeF₆ octahedra, faces with seven CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with three equivalent FeF₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 12°. There are a spread of Cs-F bond distances ranging from 3.20-3.41 Å. Na is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with three equivalent FeF₆ octahedra, faces with seven CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, and  a faceface with one FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 8°. There are three shorter (2.29 Å) and three longer (2.42 Å) Na-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and faces with eight CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 8°. All Fe-F bond lengths are 1.98 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. All Fe-F bond lengths are 1.96 Å. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Fe atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Fe atom.
